name: ignore-entry-of-another-language
description: An analyzer reads only the ignore entries whose reference names its own language. In a target both languages analyze, an entry of the other language's scheme binds nothing, counts in neither total and is reported under no code, whether it would match, lacks a path or lacks a reason, because the other language's analyzer reads the same file and reports it once. The entry of the analyzer's own language is in effect.
